## Local law

| Id | Rule |
|---|---|
| LOCAL-1 | Offline is the product: no network package in `pubspec.yaml` or `Cargo.toml`, no HTTP, socket or remote call in `lib/` or `rust/`. Encrypted output leaves only through the user's own share sheet, files or clipboard. |
| LOCAL-2 | All cryptography lives in `rust/fuzzy_crypto_core` (pinned crates only, no hand-rolled primitive). Dart holds no key bytes, no `Random.secure`, no hash, KDF or AEAD code; a new cryptographic operation is a Rust `api/` function plus bridge codegen, never a Dart helper or a Dart crypto package. Keys cross the bridge only as opaque handles (`CryptoCore`, `VaultKey`, `FileJob`, passed by reference). |
| LOCAL-3 | Before touching `rust/`, `lib/rust_bridge/` or `lib/src/core/encryption_services/`, read `documents/security/PROTOCOL.md` and `THREAT_MODEL.md`: they are the specification. Every blob starts with `FUZZ 01 <type>`; ratchet state is persisted before a result is returned; never build with `--cfg fuzzing`; no `#[frb(sync)]` on anything touching a key, Argon2 or an AEAD. |
| LOCAL-4 | In `lib/`, only `lib/src/core/encryption_services/crypto_core_service/crypto_core_service.dart` and `lib/src/app/initializer.dart` import `package:fuzzzy_seal/rust_bridge/…`; in `test/`, only `test/helpers/crypto_core_test_init.dart` and `test/src/core/rust_bridge_smoke_test.dart`. Every core call returns `CryptoCoreResponse<T>` (`CryptoCoreSuccess` or `CryptoCoreFailure`) from `CryptoCoreService`. |
| LOCAL-5 | `package:isar` is imported only by `lib/src/core/dependency_injection.dart`, `storage_models/` and `local_data_sources/`. Isar is not encrypted: a sensitive column holds a Rust-sealed blob. |
| LOCAL-6 | `flutter_rust_bridge` moves in lockstep at `2.13.0` in three places: `pubspec.yaml`, `rust/fuzzy_crypto_core/Cargo.toml` (`=2.13.0`) and the codegen that wrote `lib/rust_bridge/`. Never run `flutter_rust_bridge_codegen integrate` (it overwrites `rust_builder/`). |
| LOCAL-7 | A dependency bump ships its SBOM in the same commit: `./sbom.sh rust` or `./sbom.sh flutter` (CI fails on drift). |
| LOCAL-8 | Marionette is initialised only in `lib/main_development.dart`, under `kDebugMode`. `--flavor` is mandatory on every run and build. Timings (unlock, Argon2id, file throughput) are measured on `--profile` or release, never debug. |
| LOCAL-9 | OS and cloud backups stay opted out on every platform; `test/platform/backup_opt_out_test.dart` pins the manifests. |
| LOCAL-10 | The format check covers `lib test` only: `rust_builder/` is vendored cargokit, `lib/rust_bridge/` is formatted by its codegen. |
| LOCAL-11 | The project import is `package:fuzzzy_seal/src/src.dart` (FZ-FLT-L4) in every new file; `package:fuzzzy_seal/lib.dart` re-exports it and is what older files use. The two sanctioned extra imports: `package:fuzzzy_ui_kit/fuzzzy_ui_kit.dart`, and `package:fuzzzy_seal/rust_bridge/…` in the files LOCAL-4 names. |

<!-- Every feature folder predates the handbook. In all of them: keep the file's structure, add no new violation, never copy into new code. New modules follow the handbook shape (fuzzy_starter lib/src/sample_posts/). -->

| Folder or file | Non-conforming | Rule for editing there |
|---|---|---|
| `lib/src/fuzzzy_seal/` | `try/catch` in six cubits (`chat_creation`, `chat_general_data_list`, `connected_chat`, `file_processing`, `handshake`, `invitation_acceptance`); `sl.get` inside `file_processing_cubit`; repositories return raw values and let storage exceptions escape (`message_data_repository`, `chat_general_data_list_repository`) or share a generic response, never one sealed response per function; `storage/` (`storage_models`, `local_data_sources`) and `data/models/` instead of `data/data_sources/` and a root `models/`; 43 blocking kit-guard sites (literal colours, text styles, radii); no `qaId` anywhere | keep the file's structure, add no new violation; never copy into new code |
| `lib/src/fuzzy_auth/` | `try/catch` in `fuzzy_auth_store` and `fuzzy_user_auth_preferences_cubit`; repositories return `bool`, `void` or nullable values; `storage/` layout; 7 blocking kit-guard sites | keep the file's structure, add no new violation; never copy into new code |
| `lib/src/fuzzy_vault/` | `try/catch` in `vault_auth_cubit`; one generic `VaultResponse<T>` for every repository function; `storage/` layout; 26 blocking kit-guard sites | keep the file's structure, add no new violation; never copy into new code |
| `lib/src/fuzzy_basics/` | `try/catch` and `sl.get` inside `custom_file_processing_cubit`; an empty `data/`, a feature-local `core/` folder, no repository: the cubits call `CryptoCoreService` directly | keep the file's structure, add no new violation; never copy into new code |
| `lib/src/app/` | `try/catch` in `globals/bloc/theme_cubit`; 3 blocking kit-guard sites in `ui/pages/main_shell_page/` | keep the file's structure, add no new violation; never copy into new code |
| `lib/src/ui_kit/` | a local kit copy (`UiKitTheme`, `context.uiColors`, `Fuzzy*` widgets) beside `fuzzzy_ui_kit`; 15 blocking kit-guard sites (FZ-FLT-WIDGET-03) | add nothing here; new UI composes `fuzzzy_ui_kit` widgets; a missing widget goes to the kit, never here |
| `lib/src/core/dependency_injection.dart` | one `inject()` for every feature; the four vault cubits use raw `sl.registerFactory` (FZ-FLT-L8); `VaultAuthCubit` and `FuzzyAuthStore` are singletons | new services and repositories use `sl.safeRegisterSingleton`; a new factory is guarded by `sl.isRegistered<T>()` until the locator gains a safe factory (its own task); leave the existing lines until a task owns them |
| `lib/lib.dart`, `lib/src/app/initializer.dart`, `lib/src/fuzzzy_seal/data/models/chat_preferences.dart` | the old docs made `package:fuzzzy_seal/lib.dart` the one import (it re-exports `src/src.dart`) and most files use it; 18 files use relative imports; these two import single files | the handbook wins (LOCAL-11); an edited file keeps its imports |
| `lib/src/core/l10n/l10n.dart`, `lib/src/core/l10n/generated_localizations/generated_localizations.dart` | `./exp.sh` writes `generated_localizations/generated_localizations.dart` and exports it from `l10n.dart`, so the handbook's plain barrel check is red at base | undo both after every `./exp.sh` (the `barrels` check does); never commit them |
| `lib/src/core/services/user_file_store/`, `lib/src/fuzzy_basics/ui/pages/basic_encryption_page/`, `test/src/app/globals/`, `test/src/fuzzy_vault/ui/pages/vault_home_page/`, `test/src/fuzzzy_seal/ui/pages/connected_chat_page/widgets/` | 5 files not `dart format`-clean at base, so `format` is pending | a unit that edits one of these formats that file; never reformat files outside the unit |
| `test/src/fuzzzy_seal/bloc/file_processing_cubit/` | waits on the wall clock (`inputStabilityProbeDuration` + 150 ms settle, FZ-TEST-CLOCK-01): under machine load the full suite failed once and hung once in three runs at base | new tests use `fake_async` or `Completer` ordering; run this file alone when a unit touches it |
| `pubspec.yaml` | 27 caret ranges (22 dependencies, 5 dev dependencies: `go_router`, `isar`, `marionette_flutter`, …); the handbook pins exact versions | leave the existing ranges; a new dependency is an exact version |
| `code_generators/bricks/` | `local_brick`, `local_single_entity_brick`, `remote_brick` predate the handbook module shape; `./buildrunner.sh`, `./loc.sh` and `./m.sh` are broken (see Generators) | do not generate new modules from these bricks; never fix a script as a side effect |

## Repo facts

### Checks

Run from the repo root, on the committed tree, with `set -o pipefail`, setup first, then in the printed order; verified green 2026-10-01 at a7672bf in a fresh worktree, `git status` clean at the end (`test`: 3 of 3 runs at the branch tip).

Pending — red or unstable at base, never a must-pass check until fixed:
- format: `fvm dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test` — 5 files unformatted (Legacy zones).
- barrel-complete: `git add -A lib && ./exp.sh && git diff --exit-code lib` — the exporter's l10n side effect (Legacy zones); the `barrels` check below undoes it.
- test, `test/src/fuzzzy_seal/bloc/file_processing_cubit/`: waits on the wall clock; under load the full suite failed once and hung once in three runs at base, always in this folder. The `test` check below leaves it out; a unit touching it runs `fvm flutter test test/src/fuzzzy_seal/bloc/file_processing_cubit` alone.
- fuzzzy-ui-kit-guard: `fvm dart run fuzzzy_ui_kit:guard <folder>` — green for `lib/src/core` and `lib/src/fuzzy_basics` (checks below); red in `lib/src/app` (3 blocking), `lib/src/fuzzy_auth` (7), `lib/src/fuzzy_vault` (26), `lib/src/fuzzzy_seal` (43), `lib/src/ui_kit` (15).
- law-drift in CI: needs the handbook checkout and a read key (Repo facts "CI").

- Setup, once per fresh worktree, before any check: `fvm dart pub get && (cd rust/fuzzy_crypto_core && cargo build --release --locked)`.

| Name | Command | Fails on drift |
|---|---|---|
| analyze | `fvm flutter analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings` | — |
| barrels | `./exp.sh && git checkout -- lib/src/core/l10n/l10n.dart && rm -f lib/src/core/l10n/generated_localizations/generated_localizations.dart && git diff --exit-code -- lib` | yes |
| l10n | `fvm flutter gen-l10n && git diff --exit-code -- lib/src/core/l10n/generated_localizations` | yes |
| test | `fvm flutter test $(find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/file_processing_cubit/*')` | — |
| bridge | `flutter_rust_bridge_codegen generate && git diff --exit-code -- lib/rust_bridge rust/fuzzy_crypto_core/src/frb_generated.rs` | yes |
| kit guard core | `fvm dart run fuzzzy_ui_kit:guard lib/src/core` | — |
| kit guard basics | `fvm dart run fuzzzy_ui_kit:guard lib/src/fuzzy_basics` | — |
| rust format | `cd rust/fuzzy_crypto_core && cargo fmt --all -- --check` | — |
| rust clippy | `cd rust/fuzzy_crypto_core && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` | — |
| rust test | `cd rust/fuzzy_crypto_core && cargo test --locked` | — |
| rust audit | `cd rust/fuzzy_crypto_core && cargo audit --file Cargo.lock` | — |
| sbom rust | `./sbom.sh rust --check` | yes |

### Dependency registration
- Applies to: `lib/src/core/dependency_injection.dart`, `lib/src/*/data/**`, `lib/src/*/storage/**`, `lib/src/*/bloc/**`, `lib/src/*/ui/pages/**`
- File: `lib/src/core/dependency_injection.dart`, one static `DependencyInjection.inject()` (Isar is opened there with every `stored_*` schema).
- Locator: the global `sl` (`lib/src/core/services/service_locator/`, a GetIt wrapper). Its only safe registration is `sl.safeRegisterSingleton<T>(…)`; services, data sources and repositories use it.
- Constructor injection everywhere else; pages provide cubits with `BlocProvider(create: (_) => sl.get<T>())` or build them from injected repositories.

### Localisation
- Applies to: `lib/src/core/l10n/**`, `lib/src/*/ui/**`
- Sources: `lib/src/core/l10n/app_en.arb` (template), `app_ka.arb`; config `l10n.yaml`; class `FuzzzySealLocalizations`, read as `context.fuzzzySealLocalizations.<key>` (outside a widget: `currentContextLocalization`). Georgian is required for every key.
- Regenerate: `fvm flutter gen-l10n`
- Regenerated by tool, never hand-edited: `lib/src/core/l10n/generated_localizations/fuzzzy_seal_localizations.dart`, `fuzzzy_seal_localizations_en.dart`, `fuzzzy_seal_localizations_ka.dart`
- `./loc.sh` is broken (it sources a missing `scripts/runner.sh`): edit both `.arb` files by hand.

### Rust core and bridge
- Applies to: `rust/**`, `lib/rust_bridge/**`, `lib/src/core/encryption_services/**`, `lib/src/app/initializer.dart`, `test/helpers/**`, `test/src/core/**`
- Crate `rust/fuzzy_crypto_core` (toolchain 1.98.1 from its `rust-toolchain.toml`: run cargo from the crate folder, never with `--manifest-path` from the root, which picks the default toolchain). Every build and test is `--locked`.
- Order of work: edit `src/api/*.rs` → `cargo test --locked` → `flutter_rust_bridge_codegen generate` (from the repo root, reads `flutter_rust_bridge.yaml`) → `fvm flutter analyze` → commit with the generated files.
- Regenerated by tool, never hand-edited: `lib/rust_bridge/frb_generated.dart`, `lib/rust_bridge/frb_generated.io.dart`, `lib/rust_bridge/frb_generated.web.dart`, `lib/rust_bridge/error.dart`, `lib/rust_bridge/api/core.dart`, `files.dart`, `formats.dart`, `health.dart`, `pairing.dart`, `passwords.dart`, `vault.dart`, `rust/fuzzy_crypto_core/src/frb_generated.rs`
- Regenerate: `flutter_rust_bridge_codegen generate`
- `fvm flutter test` loads `rust/fuzzy_crypto_core/target/release/libfuzzy_crypto_core.{dylib,so}`: rebuild it (`cargo build --release --locked`) after any Rust change. A test that touches the core calls `initCryptoCoreForTests()` (`test/helpers/crypto_core_test_init.dart`) in `setUpAll`.
- `CoreError` is mirrored exhaustively by `CryptoCoreFailureType` (`lib/src/core/encryption_services/crypto_core_service/components/crypto_core_failure_type.dart`); a new error variant changes both in one commit.

### Storage (Isar)
- Applies to: `lib/src/*/storage/**`, `lib/src/core/dependency_injection.dart`
- Models are `storage/storage_models/stored_*.dart` with committed `.g.dart` twins; local data sources in `storage/local_data_sources/`.
- `./buildrunner.sh` is broken and `build_runner` / `isar_generator` are not in the pubspec: a changed model is regenerated in a scratch package outside the repo (`isar ^3.1.0+1`, `build_runner ^2.4.0`, `isar_generator ^3.1.0+1`), after proving the unchanged model regenerates byte-identical; then the schema goes into `Isar.open`.

### Tests and harness
- Applies to: `test/**`
- Layout: `test/src/<feature>/<layer>/…` mirroring `lib/src/` (`bloc/<name>_cubit/`, `data/repositories/`, `ui/pages/<page>/`); platform manifest tests in `test/platform/`.
- Doubles: `mocktail` (`class Mock<Name> extends Mock implements <Type> {}`); cubits with `bloc_test`. A test that needs `sl` registers with `sl.safeRegisterSingleton<T>(…)` in `setUp` and calls `sl.unregister<T>()` in `tearDown`.
- Widget harness: `MaterialApp(theme: FuzzzyTheme.build(inkPack, FuzzzySkin.night), localizationsDelegates: FuzzzySealLocalizations.localizationsDelegates, …)` inside the test file; there is no shared pump helper.
- Time: `fake_async` or `Completer` ordering, never the wall clock (FZ-TEST-CLOCK-01); `fake_async` arrives only through `flutter_test` (not a direct dev dependency yet).

### Failures
- Applies to: `lib/src/*/data/**`, `lib/src/*/storage/**`, `lib/src/*/bloc/**`, `lib/src/core/encryption_services/**`, `lib/src/core/error_handling/**`
- There is no HTTP layer. Failures come from the core (`CryptoCoreFailure(CryptoCoreFailureType)`: `unsupportedFormat`, `invalidSignature`, `invitationAlreadyUsed`, `wrongChat`, `replay`, `tooOld`, `corrupt`, `wrongPassword`, `storeLocked`, `unknownChat`, `io`, `cancelled`, `internal`) and from local storage.
- UI failure types live in `lib/src/core/error_handling/ui_failures/` (`chat_creation_failure`, `connected_chat_failure`, `file_processing_failure`, `chat_archive_export_failure`); `DefaultFailure` in `lib/src/core/error_handling/default_failure.dart`.

### Kit widgets
- Applies to: `lib/src/*/ui/**`, `test/src/*/ui/**`
- Kit: `fuzzzy_ui_kit` 0.1.0 from git `fuzzzy-bot/fuzzy_design` at ref `f6f08b2b`; import only `package:fuzzzy_ui_kit/fuzzzy_ui_kit.dart`. Theme: `FuzzzyTheme.build(inkPack, FuzzzySkin.night)`.
- Roles: `context.fuzzzyColors`, `context.fuzzzyTextStyles`, gaps from `context.fuzzzySpace`, padding from `context.fuzzzyDensity`, radii from `context.fuzzzyRadius` (FZ-FLT-ROLE-02). No literal sizes. Every interactive element carries a `qaId` (none does today).

| `FuzzzyTextField` | `label` · `hint` · `errorText` · `controller` · `onChanged` · `onSubmitted` · `obscure` · `keyboardType` · `maxLines` · `qaId` | `field.<qaId>` |
| `FuzzzyAppBar` | `title` (required) · `leading` · `onLeading` · `actions` · `qaId` | `<qaId>` (default `appbar`), back `<qaId>.back` |
| `FuzzzyIconButton` | `icon` (required) · `onPressed` · `variant` · `semanticLabel` · `qaId` | `iconbtn.<qaId>` |
| `FuzzzyEmptyState` | `title` (required) · `message` · `action` · `sunMark` · `qaId` | `empty.<qaId>` |
| `FuzzzyProgressRing` | `value` · `size` · `qaId` | `progress.<qaId>` |

### Generators

| Command | Rewrites |
|---|---|
| `./exp.sh` | the barrel `<dir>/<dir>.dart` in every folder under `lib/src` (adds exports, never removes one); also writes `lib/src/core/l10n/generated_localizations/generated_localizations.dart` and its export in `lib/src/core/l10n/l10n.dart`, which are undone (Legacy zones) |
| `fvm flutter gen-l10n` | `lib/src/core/l10n/generated_localizations/` |
| `flutter_rust_bridge_codegen generate` | `lib/rust_bridge/**` and `rust/fuzzy_crypto_core/src/frb_generated.rs` |
| `./sbom.sh rust` · `./sbom.sh flutter` | `documents/security/sbom/rust.cdx.json` · `flutter.cdx.json` (`--check` compares only) |
| `./buildrunner.sh` · `./loc.sh` · `./m.sh` (broken, never run) | — (see Storage, Localisation; `python3 scripts/merge_contents.py <path>` replaces `./m.sh`) |

### CI
- Applies to: `.github/**`, `codemagic.yaml`
- `.github/workflows/main.yaml` on every push to `main` and `agent/**`, tags `v*` and pull requests: rust (fmt, clippy, test, audit, SBOM), flutter-test (format, analyze `--fatal-infos --fatal-warnings`, test, SBOM), android (16 KB page check), linux, windows, macos, reproducible core, attest (tags). `codemagic.yaml` builds signed releases on `v*` tags.
- law-drift job: checks out `fuzzzy-bot/fuzzzy_handbook` (private) with the repository secret `FUZZZY_HANDBOOK_DEPLOY_KEY` and runs `python3 <handbook>/tools/check_law_drift.py --only fuzzy_chat --repo fuzzy_chat=.`; it checks out the handbook's `master` (`ref: master`; the GitHub default branch is not master) and is red until that secret exists and the handbook registry carrying fuzzy_chat is merged to `master`.
- Known red: `flutter-test` already fails at base on its format step (5 unformatted files, Legacy zones). Pushes to the integration branch `production-preparation` do not trigger the workflow.
